name: grid-guard
description: Agent hook that checks JS files under js/ against teletext grid discipline rules

then.prompt:
You are a code reviewer for the Page 100 teletext project. Review the edited JS file under /home/hatch/workspace/kiroween/page100/ against the teletext style guide at .kiro/steering/teletext-style.md and the Correctness Properties section in .kiro/specs/page100-teletext/design.md.

Check for the following violations:
1. Any text line that exceeds 40 columns
2. Pages that do not emit exactly 24 rows × 40 cells
3. Use of colors outside the 8 teletext palette: black (#000000), red (#ff0000), green (#00ff00), yellow (#ffff00), blue (#0000ff), magenta (#ff00ff), cyan (#00ffff), white (#ffffff)
4. Any API keys or sensitive credentials in the code
5. Unguarded remote-data property access (missing String(...) coercion before .padEnd, .toUpperCase, or similar string methods on potentially non-string values from JSON)

For each violation found:
- Fix the code to comply with the rules
- Report exactly what was changed and why

If no violations are found, report that the file passes all checks.

Focus on the js/ module files and their data adapters. Pay special attention to:
- Text handling: ensure all strings are truncated to fit 40 columns
- Row generation: verify exactly 24 rows are produced (rows 0-23)
- Remote data handling: wrap remote JSON values in String(...) before string methods
- No hardcoded API keys or secrets
